title: Occurrence
description: An individually scheduled event time associated with a When schedule.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this occurrence.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Occurrence" for Occurrence entities.

startsAt.description: UTC timestamp when the event starts.

duration.description: Nonnegative ISO 8601 event duration overriding When.duration; omission inherits the schedule default.
